entities.name: Boc-L-leucine
observations: The carboxylic acid is converted to an amide while the Boc-protected amino group remains unchanged.

entities.name: N,O-dimethylhydroxylamine
observations: Decoded small reactant is CNOC, corresponding to N-methyl-O-methylhydroxylamine; it supplies the N-methoxy-N-methyl amide group.

entities.name: Boc-L-leucine Weinreb amide
observations: Decoded product is CON(C)C(=O)[C@H](CC(C)C)NC(=O)OC(C)(C)C, the N-methoxy-N-methyl amide of Boc-L-leucine.

entities.name: Boc-L-leucine Weinreb amidation
observations: Transformation is carboxylic-acid amidation with N,O-dimethylhydroxylamine; a separate carboxyl-activating reagent is required but is not encoded in the supplied reaction string.
